title: George of Clarence
summary: Raleigh names George of Clarence in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Undated in this intake: no yeere of the World was taken from the covered text except where a chronology entry quotes one. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
